summary_en: TOLI Corporation announced a ToSTNeT-3 off-floor share buyback at a fixed price of 721 yen per share on November 5, 2026. The company will acquire up to 1,010,000 shares (1.78% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) with a maximum expenditure of 728.21 million yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Share Buyback through Off-Floor Share Buyback Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 4, 2026, TOLI Corporation announced that its board of directors had decided to execute a portion of a previously authorized share buyback through ToSTNeT-3, an off-floor trading mechanism. The company will acquire up to 1,010,000 shares at a fixed price of 721 yen per share on November 5, 2026, at 8:45 a.m. in Tokyo Stock Exchange trading. This represents 1.78% of outstanding shares (calculated from issued shares excluding treasury stock) with a maximum total expenditure of 728,210,000 yen. The order will be valid only during the designated trading time window, and results will be disclosed after the close of trading that same morning.

This execution is part of a broader buyback authorization made by the board on November 2, 2026, which permits the company to acquire up to 1,100,000 shares for a maximum of 880,000,000 yen through November 28, 2026. After completion of this ToSTNeT-3 purchase, TOLI intends to conduct additional market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange using the remaining authorized budget and share count.
